_doc: Single source for the atlas worker protocol: the cheap mechanical tier, the dispatch blocks it adds on top of the five in hooks/dispatch_tripwire.py REQUIRED_SPEC_BLOCKS, and the fixed report every atlas worker returns. Read by hooks/dispatch_tripwire.py (REPORT: required on every atlas:* dispatch; STEPS: required and capped for the mechanical agent), hooks/worker_report_gate.py (Claude Code SubagentStop check of the final message) and omp/worker-report.ts (injects the report outputSchema, strict, into atlas task items on omp). The tier is chosen by the lead through the agent name: runner = mechanical (exact steps, no decisions), implementer and explorer = standard (bounded work from a stated spec), verifier and the audit agents = judgment. Claude Code tiers are the agent frontmatter model and effort; omp tiers are role aliases resolved through modelRoles with the built-in @smol as the guaranteed fallback (omp ships smol, not tiny).
